Original detailed cinematic manga for ZERO-SUM: OMEN. Meticulous variable-weight black ink, selective crosshatching and controlled halftone, expressive anatomy and hands, clear perspective, tactile brass machinery and repaired clothing, matte gouache architectural depth, restrained colour accents. Serious action has weight and aftermath; comedy uses stillness and simplified expression. Teen-rated peril, no gore or sexualization. Preserve supplied character identity and asymmetric props. English left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Exact rectangular layout follows the coordinates below, with clean white gutters. Draw NO lettering, numerals, logos, sound effects, speech balloons, captions, HUD or readable signs. Leave quiet upper areas for separate lettering. Every required digit and word is a later vector layer. No imitation of a named artist or existing franchise. NIL uses they/them, RIGHT decoder, one orange hair streak, three abacus clasps, longer LEFT coat tail. Vesper has LEFT braid, two blank hat cards, seven-chamber gun. Varro is human under a repaired hound mask, with three jars. Never mirror these actors.
Colour script: slate rain, bone paper and warm amber brass; signature colour only at the focal actor.
Panel p011_01 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.05, 0.9, 0.26]: NIL sincerely perplexed; Vesper grin starts. Small still comic beat before action.
Panel p011_02 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.33, 0.9, 0.18]: Hound charges. Vesper planted left, NIL centre behind, clear floor, empty three-tube reel.
Panel p011_03 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.53, 0.43, 0.2]: Vesper points to two lit blank tubes, gun lowered for instruction; reads situation, no lecture.
Panel p011_04 at normalized rectangle [0.52, 0.53, 0.43, 0.2]: Macro final wheel: legal blank faces have shape-coded completion markers; information, not forced perfect stop.
Panel p011_05 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.75, 0.9, 0.2]: NIL steps into stop, Vesper covers side; paired attack drives hound right toward drain rail.
Use an exact1000x1500 composition grid (scale proportionally to the output). Panel pixel boxes [x,y,w,h]: p011_01 [50, 75, 900, 390]; p011_02 [50, 495, 900, 270]; p011_03 [50, 795, 430, 300]; p011_04 [520, 795, 430, 300]; p011_05 [50, 1125, 900, 300]. Keep all art inside these boxes; gutters remain plain paper.
FINAL CONTINUITY: Draw ONLY this page's listed story cast: nil, vesper, debthound.  Do not add other named characters from style notes or other pages. The priest must NOT appear before the shrine entrance scene. Every mechanical readout is EMPTY SMOKED GLASS, never a portrait mirror; Civic/Audit/NaN lettering is added later. Preserve panel count, geometry and required geography. Clean 4K portrait page, no lettering, no balloons. Broad clean upper panel areas for separate text, faces/hands placed below those zones. Fine controlled ink detail at focal areas; strong black shapes and selective crosshatching; readable painted atmosphere, no glossy photorealism.
